articles.title: Uranus Is at Its Best and Brightest Tonight
articles.summary: Uranus reaches opposition on November 25, its closest and brightest point of the year. Find it near the Pleiades with binoculars or a telescope.

articles.title: Earth's Next Ice Age May Have Started, Then Stopped
articles.summary: New research finds Earth's next glacial period may have begun 2,000 years ago in the Canadian Arctic, only for global warming to stop it by the 1960s.

articles.title: A 2,200-Year-Old Shipwreck's Sticky Secret
articles.summary: A Roman shipwreck off Croatia reveals two ancient waterproofing recipes, pine tar and pine tar mixed with beeswax, plus pollen that traces where the ship was built and repaired.
